_comment: Copy to ~/.asmltr/tool-policy.json (or set ASMLTR_TOOL_POLICY_FILE). Principal ids must match trust store principals.id — placeholders only, never real names. discordIds are numeric Discord user ids; leave empty in git and fill locally. photoAllow / imageAllow: stills + asmltr post, not video. videoAllow: clips AND stills. mediaAllow: both. codeAllow: write-a-program for that caller. Empty list = owner/bypass only. Recommended: list Access-card principal ids under photoAllow if they may generate stills; leave videoAllow empty unless you want clips. Same-guild Discord post is NOT this file — that is principals.default_tier 1–5 (see seed.example.json).
